text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting, says serving people and their interests should be among first priorities.
- Parliamentary speaker Saadoun Hammadi says in Moscow that this year will see end of oil embargo on Iraq.
- Moroccan newspaper calls for Arab solidarity.
- Kurdish rebels in Turkey responsible for latest explosions in Turkish weapons factory.
- Libya denounces latest nuclear experiment by United States.
- Kuwaiti finance minister charged with corruption.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and THAWRA)
- Article on link between production and incentives.
- Article on lessons to be learned from return of Hong Kong to China.
- Commentary on what Arab countries can do to ease Iraq's suffering emanating from U.N. trade sanctions.
- Commentary attacks joint Saudi-Egyptian communique urging Iraq to comply with all U.N. resolutions related to 1991 Gulf War.
